title: Reduce Service State
description: Folds a stream of pipeline values into a single accumulated result using a user-defined reducer expression. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/reduce)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

initialState.description: Starting value for reducedState. Also resets the accumulator when updated.

reducer.description: Expression evaluated per tick. Uses the same expression syntax as [Map](./map.md).

resetReducer.description: When true, resets reducedState back to initialState on next configure call
